name: alert
description: A highlighted message, like a banner, an error in a form, or a flash message. Has an optional icon, title, and close button.

props.variant: warning, danger, info, or notice. Adds alert--warning, alert--danger, alert--info, or alert--notice. alert is an alias for danger, to match the Rails and Devise flash key. With no variant, the alert is neutral.
props.tone: outlined, muted, or filled. Adds alert--outlined, alert--muted, or alert--filled. Outlined is the default.
props.flash: Adds alert--flash: the alert slides in at the top right, stays, and slides out. It dismisses itself when the animation ends.
props.onDismiss: React: called with the event when the close button is clicked or a flash ends. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the alert. Web component: an op-alert-dismiss event that you can cancel. If it is not canceled, the alert removes itself.
props.role: alert by default. Set role="status" for a message that should not interrupt a screen reader.

props.name: The icon's name. Takes every Icon prop. Size is large and weight is bold by default. Plain HTML: add icon--large and icon--weight-bold.

props.children: The title and one or more descriptions, stacked.
Optional. A short heading for the message.
The message. Use more than one for more than one message.

props.label: Text for screen readers. Dismiss by default.
props.onClick: React: called before the alert dismisses. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the alert. Plain HTML: write the <button> and remove the alert with your own JS.

modifiers.alert--outlined: The default tone: a light background and a border
modifiers.alert--muted: A darker background and no border
modifiers.alert--filled: The strongest background and no border
modifiers.alert--flash: Fixed at the top right of the screen, with a slide in and out animation

customPropertiesNote: Border and shadow values are box shadows. Use var(--op-border-none) to draw nothing. Each variant and tone sets the background, color, border color, and title color. Make a new variant with a modifier class that sets only these variables.

alert.--op-alert-gap: Space between the icon, messages, and close button
alert.--op-alert-flash-inset: Space from the top and right of the screen for a flash alert. The default animation slides to --op-space-large, so it uses this only with the animation set to none
alert.--op-alert-flash-animation: The flash animation. Set it to none to keep a flash alert on screen

alert__messages.--op-alert-messages-gap: Space between the title and descriptions

alert__title.--op-alert-title-color: Title text color. Each variant and tone sets it

alert__close.--op-alert-close-size: Width and height of the close button
alert__close.--op-alert-close-radius: Corner radius of the close button
alert__close.--op-alert-close-border-hover: The close button's border when hovered
